title: Transfer item: cautious
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: The witness gave a ___ account: she reported only what she had seen and openly said when she was uncertain.

choice_rationales.A: Timid suggests fear or lack of confidence, which the sentence does not establish.
choice_rationales.B: Cautious describes deliberate care to avoid claiming more than the evidence supports.
choice_rationales.C: Evasive criticises someone for avoiding a direct answer, but the witness reports what she knows and identifies uncertainty honestly.
choice_rationales.D: Vague means lacking clear detail; the sentence focuses instead on evidence boundaries and honest uncertainty.

parts.hint: Choose the option that treats evidence limits as responsible care rather than fear, avoidance or lack of detail.
parts.correct_explanation: The witness limits claims to direct observation and labels uncertainty, so ‘cautious’ preserves the responsible attitude of the account.
